g.text: F126.1 delete the old evals: the architecture
The studio's own tests and the
API's integration tests of it go (5)
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: An arrow means references. Each part goes only after everything that references it has let go, so every step still builds. The number in brackets is the step that removes a part or changes it. The agent API references two eval projects and uses nothing from them.
